title: Add shared Stripe client and application config
description: Introduces a central config module with environment overrides and a small helper that builds the Stripe client the billing endpoints share.

expected.note: A secret key literal is committed as the fallback value, so the key ships in source and in every checkout. The fallback must not contain a key at all; read it from the environment and fail loudly when it is missing.
The secret key is written to the logs on every client construction, leaking it to log aggregation and console history. Remove the log line or log only a non-sensitive identifier.
